scope: Editor open/session restore isolation across host close and epoch replacement

tests.rawLogProvenance: Exact stdout returned by exec_command, preserved without reconstructing per-test details.

tests.includes: editor lifecycle signal.aborted guard and App pre-await ticket integration

behavior: Host close and project epoch replacement invalidate prior project tickets; ordinary A-to-B navigation preserves A pending reads.
A pre-close restore ticket cannot clear detached state; a fresh activation at the same epoch can reopen retained tabs.
Every awaited open stage verifies epoch/generation and attached state before continuing.
Stale open completion cannot delete a newer in-flight open for the same key.
Interrupted session restore leaves pending tabs restorable; old cleanup cannot clear a new restore barrier.
Inactive A read failures do not publish global error over project B.
The preview replacement close chain validates ticket and exact buffer ownership after each wait; an old document_close response cannot delete the rebound same-key buffer or tab.
limitations: No native app or GUI execution performed for these changes. Candidate8 visible sleep/wake regression remains separate.
